_comment: Machine-readable transcription of the early-stop condition in the FROZEN pre-registration. The frozen region is pinned by G5.1 and must not be edited, so the rule cannot live inside it in executable form; it lives here, next to its source and its source's digest, and `tests/test_bench_qualification.py` asserts the two still agree. A rule a human has to remember to apply is not a rule -- C-2 is the proof: it fired after task 2 and ten more tasks ran anyway.
text: Dừng sớm, chốt trước (giao thức đã khai): nếu hai task đầu đều 6/6 phiên PASS ở cả hai điều kiện thì model mới cũng chạm trần bộ dữ liệu này — dừng, báo, đừng đốt thêm bảy giờ để lấy một cột toàn số 1,00.
